questions.passage: Jet lag is a (A)[temporary / permanent] sleep problem that occurs when your body's internal clock is not synchronized with the time zone that you are in. Traveling west (B)[lengthens / shortens] the body clock's experience of the normal day-night cycle. Traveling east, however, shortens one's experience of this cycle.
